book.name: Qayeeng yeip yaing
book.title: Kilisi talex qayeeng xupekeing yeip yaing wou Yoan

content: Qayeeng wei la tax

Qayeeng xupekeing wei Yesu Kilisi wong e yeip yaing. Wei Anutu wong wou e bei e talex wou e xe xel xukxe en vati wei embim nam mendei yanyateiv o. E wong e xe angela ti lam wong qayeeng ne wou a Yoan, e xe xukxe,
wei neil lulul sapa wei Yoan yei yo teyei, inye xoulek wei Anutu yo me pavulek en Yesu Kilisi yo.
Anutu e bong mata wou tiwei mi pyaw qayeeng poropet ne yo, me e bong mata wou xel wei mi ngo qayeeng ne me betiwou vatiyeiw wei yeip eivek qayeeng ne yo, en bouk lam paviy.
Yoan neil e xe xeilala la wou kongrikesin lim yuw
A Yoan,
A byex qayeeng ne wou kongrikesin lim yuw wei provins Esia yo:

Anutu xe lalei xeiles is lalei vevopeing e nak wou xam, inye lam wou e wei mindei gweimbeeng ne me e wei mindei takwei me e wei tyek mendi nam o, me lalei xeiles is lalei vevopeing lam wou laweeng lim yuw wei mi nale wou e xe siaking o,
Yesu Kilisi tiwei mi neil Anutu xe qayeeng dalus la wo bombek. E tambiy tiwei qandi lek veil meyeing myaxeeng o, me wo gyovaxa en kingyeiyeiw wei tembuing o.
Tiwei lalei vind xey me wong xey a lam myayaing veil sewokeing nangya e gyand o,
me wong xey a teyei lek tete lalei me lumukiyeiw bei na bong xuk wei e xe Anutu me Ma yo, xeiyaing ngandoung me nikanzek wei yeingteyei lulul o ena wou e me na mi mendei luta luta! Zonghek.

content.text: Wei, e di lam is laxap,
me xomaxoneing sapa tyek gyei e lek mendghalus,
me xel wei beum e en yiy eno tyek gyei is,
me xel veleivlei dalus wei tembuing eno tyek bong talot en e!
Om lul tine tyek bo neing lek! Zonghek.

content: Tambiy Ngandoung Anutu neil, “A ne Tax me a Loxyus, wei a toundei ne, me a mindei takwei, me a wei tyek mendi nam o, Anutu Nikanzekta.”
Tambiy ti nambei xomaxoneing neu moux ti

Ay, Yoan, xam limim me xe xouing a toundei is ama eivek myavanei me tete lalei me xe xouing a mi axe me nale nikanzek eivek myavanei wei xe xe yo eivek Yesu, me a deilek tembuing danghei tiwei di yeip eivek mamileeng wei Patmos o en xoulek wei Anutu yo me pavulek en Yesu yo.
Lek Tambiy Ngandoung xe bouk eno a toundei eivek Laweeng Vambuing, me na ngo loum deming eno vya ngandoung ti nambei vukxax ti,
wei neil embei: “Byex lek qapiya ti en vati wei wang wei yo me wong ela wou kongrikesin lim yuw. Ena wou Epeses, Smena, Pegamum, me Taiataira, Sadis, Piladelpia me Laodisia.”
A pekwi mang bei na ghe vya wei di luk wou ay yo. Deka a pekwi mang eno a xei lam ghol vaxa lim yuw,
me eivek xel lam vaxa yon senghoing eno tambiy ti nambei xomaxoneing neu moux ti, vunek en teimb ding wei la tei wou e vaxa me vex let ghol wei vivekwou e bambou kanzek.
E lu me luvelus eno wo pus nambei sipsip nivlus, me wo teleing nambei laxap, me e ma nei xok nenyex wei tum magyand o.
E vaxa nei nambei bras tumeing eivek nenyex ngandoung o me e vya ne nambei memiing nindenduing wei mi la nikanzek o.
Eivek e mema payeiv e zeim betum lim yuw, me ngeyeing vevek wei manewou yuw valuvalu eno lam myayaing veil e mya. E ma ne nambei sayeiv wei mi siing ngandoung me la danghei danghei nei.
Ka a xei e, a teila lek e vaxa de wambeik nge a mey. Woyom e liw mema payeiv lek a me neil, “Wa se gwaleeng. A ne Tax me a Loxyus.
A ne a mindei mapieing o, a mey takwei nei. Ekom ngo, a toundei mapieing luta luta ne! Me a zeim xel ki wei meyeing me beyeeng wei meyeing o.
“Byex qayeeng en vati wei wang wei ne, vati wei toundei gweimbeeng ne, me vati wei tyek nam yus o.

Lul xupekeing wei betum lim yuw wei wang wei eivek a memang payeiv o me lam vaxa ghol lim yuw eno qes ambei nye: Betum lim yuw eno inye angelayeiw wei kongrikesin lim yuw o, me lam vaxa lim yuw eno inye kongrikesin lim yuw.”
